study_title: Fitted Operator Geometry Reveals Brain-State Structure and Sleep Transitions
status_note: This file freezes the confirmatory analysis contract for the public repository. It is not a claim that every analysis was registered on an external registry before any data were seen. Exploratory analyses must remain labeled exploratory in manuscript and code.

frozen_parameters.operator_model: VAR(1) on sliding windows after current-source density and principal component analysis
frozen_parameters.legacy_ep_score_definition: Per-window proximity score used in checked-in JSON keys ep_score / ep_score_mean: eigenvector_overlap / (minimum_eigenvalue_gap + 1e-10). Implemented by cmcc.features.operator_geometry.geometry_proximity_score and detect_exceptional_points.
frozen_parameters.manuscript_nd_score_definition: Within-subject composite ND = 0.5 * [z(-log10(gap + 1e-12)) + z(log10(condition_number + 1e-12))]. Implemented by cmcc.features.operator_geometry.compute_nd_score. Distinct from legacy ep_score; both summarize crowding and non-orthogonality.
frozen_parameters.subject_boundary_rule: All confirmatory contrasts and cross-validation preserve subject identity; no subject appears in both train and test folds
frozen_parameters.shared_subspace_control: Confirmatory state contrasts are also reported under PCA fit once per subject on pooled states, then applied to each state

primary_predictions.statement: High-gamma branching ratio is lower (more subcritical) than broadband branching ratio in primary intracranial electroencephalography subjects.
Near-degeneracy (ND) score positively correlates with branching ratio across primary subjects.
Minimum eigenvalue spacing distinguishes propofol sedation from wakefulness with a nonzero paired effect under the frozen pipeline.
Minimum eigenvalue spacing distinguishes rapid-eye-movement sleep from N3 under the frozen pipeline.
Spectral radius shows a pre-transition shift before N2-to-N3 onset that survives non-overlapping-window validation.

secondary_predictions: Spacing effects are largely independent of alpha power (propofol) and delta power (sleep) under the frozen pipeline.
Shared-subspace principal component analysis preserves the direction of confirmatory propofol and sleep spacing contrasts.
Phase-randomized surrogate controls constrain interpretation of absolute spectral-sensitivity magnitude.
explicit_non_claims: No claim of mathematically exact exceptional points in neural tissue.
No causal claim that operator geometry generates conscious state.
ds004752 task-condition geometry contrasts are exploratory generalization checks, not primary replications.

leakage_policy.summary: Subject-preserving splits, causal temporal features for future targets, no silent averaging, confirmatory tuning frozen away from evaluation labels.
